ly_do: chenh AUC e5 - bkai: CAU +0.0000, DOAN +0.0521 (can >= 0.05 tren CA HAI); e5 KHONG dat nguong tren CAU -> giu mac dinh bkai (nho hon, 515 MiB).
quy_tac: Chon e5 chi khi e5 nap duoc va AUC cua e5 vuot bkai >= 0.05 tren CA tap CAU va tap DOAN, dong thoi e5 encode 300 cau <= 20 s va peak RSS <= 2560 MB (2.5 GiB). Neu bkai khong nap duoc hoac truot cong 20 s trong khi e5 qua ca cong do tre va cong bo nho -> chon e5. Neu ca hai truot cong do tre -> chon bkai va ghi ro rui ro (du phong: backend ONNX, 04-RESEARCH Pattern 2). Moi truong hop con lai -> chon bkai (nho hon, 515 MiB; uu tien vi may dung chung bo nho).
